_comment: Hand-picked teams with a story worth following — players choose one to root for. Scoring depends only on how far the team advances (see scoring.js), not on which team is picked.
pays_if: the team reaches the Round of 16 or beyond — points grow the further they go

teams.name: Norway
teams.story: Erling Haaland leads them to their first World Cup since 1998

teams.name: Morocco
teams.story: 2022 semi-finalists — the deepest run ever by an African nation — back for more

teams.name: Japan
teams.story: Beat both Germany and Spain in the 2022 group stage; always a banana skin for giants

teams.name: Croatia
teams.story: Modrić's likely last World Cup — the team that went from nowhere to the 2018 final

teams.name: Egypt
teams.story: Mohamed Salah's last shot at a World Cup moment to remember

teams.name: USA
teams.story: Co-hosts riding a home crowd, built around a young core led by Pulisic

teams.name: Mexico
teams.story: Co-hosts with one of football's most passionate fanbases, hunting to finally break their Round-of-16 ceiling

teams.name: Uruguay
teams.story: A nation of 3.4 million with two World Cup titles — football's biggest overachievers
